video.title: Southborough Special Open School Committee June 4, 2026

summary.headline: The Southborough School Committee unanimously appointed Daniel Mazur as the district's new Director of Student Support Services.
summary.summary: In a brief special meeting, the Southborough School Committee voted unanimously to accept the superintendent's recommendation and appoint Daniel Mazur as Director of Student Support Services for Southborough K-8. Mazur currently serves as assistant director of special education in the Acton-Boxborough Regional School District. District leadership will now negotiate an employment contract and coordinate a transition schedule, targeting an official start date around July 1.

topics.title: Appointment of Director of Student Support Services
topics.summary: Superintendent Gregory Martineau recommended Daniel Mazur to fill the role of Director of Student Support Services for the Southborough K-8 schools following an extensive search and interview process. Committee members praised Mazur's qualifications and interview performance before voting unanimously to confirm the appointment. The superintendent and Mazur will finalize contract details and work with the Acton-Boxborough administration on transition arrangements.
key_details: Daniel Mazur currently serves as assistant director of special education for the Acton-Boxborough Regional School District.
Mazur previously served as special education team chair at Hopkinton Middle School and started his special education career at the New England Center for Children in Southborough.
School committee members met with Mazur earlier in the week during a Q&A session at the Mary E. Finn School.
District officials are targeting a July 1 start date, with flexibility depending on Acton-Boxborough transition needs.
Southborough's Extended School Year (ESY) program begins on July 6.
topics.why_it_matters: The Director of Student Support Services oversees special education programming and related student services across all Southborough K-8 schools.
